name: DynamicLake
soft_passes: #1 baked white bezel follows the mask radius (no mismatch) but baking bezel+inner-shadow deviates from current HIG
#2 no discrete central glyph to grid; notch is centred and the field is full-bleed by design
#9 internally consistent but a hybrid (Big Sur gradient squircle carrying a skeuomorphic phone-bezel quote), one era behind Liquid Glass
failures: #3 filled solid black it is a blank squircle; the notch is too small to carry the silhouette
#4 the notch (~10% width) vanishes below Dock size — at 16px it is just a purple square, subject lost
#7 notch #2C2446 vs top field #362D55 is near-isoluminant, well under 3:1, disappears in grayscale
#10 not built as Liquid Glass layers; in mono/tinted/clear the notch collapses and only a frame remains

palette.background: ramp #362D55->#57449A->#8E68D7->#E6A2F7 (dark indigo top to pink glow bottom, inverted sky logic)

light_model: internal screen glow: diffuse source at bottom-center, dark falloff to top; baked inner shadow under the top bezel; no glass specular or refraction
rhymes_hint: gradient-field object icons that render a phone/display inside a device bezel — wallpaper managers, notch/Dynamic-Island utilities, screen-recorder tools
notes: 204x204 web render, not a 1024 master — LANCZOS-soft edges; fine bezel/specular px estimated, hash 73e116ce. Strong palette coherence with the app: cover.png shows the same purple wallpaper gradient with the black Dynamic Island notification pill, so the icon literally depicts what the app does (good subject communication). Core problem: entire identity rests on the notch, which fails silhouette (#3) and 16px (#4) — the two non-negotiable Dock/Spotlight tests. Baked bezel + inner shadow are HIG deviations for macOS 26 (system should apply bezel/shadow/glass). No overlay tool; the frame is the device quote. First screen-depicting/device-frame icon in the corpus — synthesis: candidate seed for a 'screen-quote' icon cluster, not yet promotable (single app).
